card.name: The word dose in headings and radiation tables
card.fires_on: The word dose (or its pieces: Dose, dos in overdosage, dosage) when it is a heading word or follows 'absorbed'. It appears mostly in radiopharmaceutical dosimetry tables, overdosage sections and 'Dose Modification' headings.

modes.label: Absorbed dose in dosimetry
modes.description: The word dose right after 'absorbed' in radiation dose tables and radiation overdose advice.
modes.example: Table 1 Tc 99m Exametazime Labeled Leukocytes Organ Absorbed<< dose>> per unit activity administered Absorbed dose

modes.label: Dose in section headings
modes.description: The piece 'ose' after a capital D at the start of a numbered heading.
modes.example: 2.4 D<<ose>> in Patients with Renal Impairment

modes.label: Inside overdosage
modes.description: The middle piece of the word overdosage in the overdosage section.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE In the event of administration of a radiation overd<<os>>age with PLUVICTO, reduce

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted tokens are unrelated multilingual words, with perhaps a slight push toward measurement and quantity terms.
